title: Concept: gRPC service list exposed
description: A service list from server reflection in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Reflection lists every service and method the process serves, including admin services the client never calls.
applicability: Deployments that render a service list from server reflection into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Reflection lists every service and method the process serves, including admin services the client never calls.
